Source.Name: libglib-testing
Source.Summary: libglib-testing is a test library providing test harnesses and mock classes which complement the classes provided by GLib
Source.Description:
libglib-testing is a test library providing test harnesses and mock classes which complement the classes provided by GLib. It is intended to be used by any project which uses GLib and which wants to write internal unit tests.
libglib-testing is a separate project from GLib itself for two reasons: • To allow unstable API to be prototyped before being stabilised. • To keep test harness API out of libglib, since it should only be needed at test time, not at runtime.
